versions.content:
[SWS_CM_00081] Deserializing incomplete data on the proxy side belonging
to an event and
eventReceptionDefaultValue
is defined in case of
Signal-
Based IEEE1722 ACF
network binding
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00006, RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00202
⌈
If less data than expected shall be deserialized on the proxy side and the data to
be deserialized belongs to an Event and the
eventReceptionDefaultValue
is de-
fined, then the
eventReceptionDefaultValue
shall be used as a substitute for the
missing data.
⌋
